name: Marching Cubes with Hermite Data and Full Case Table
definition: An implementation of Marching-Cubes isosurface extraction that supports Hermite Data and a full case table to resolve ambiguous cases present in the original Lorensen and Cline implementation.
summary: This method extends Marching Cubes by using Hermite interpolation for geometric accuracy and a full case table to resolve topological ambiguities, producing a more faithful isosurface representation.
